---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
author: "Samuel Sammartano"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")

mallards |> slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(duck_id, name = "n_fixes") |>
  arrange(desc(n_fixes))
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarize(
    min_lat = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lat = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_long = min(long, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_long = max(long, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
